description: This Java source file defines the EntityEcaCondition class, which represents a condition used in entity event condition actions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic for evaluating conditions, possibly via service calls, and manages condition attributes such as fields, operators, and comparison types.

classes.name: EntityEcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition for entity event actions, capable of evaluating itself based on entity data or by invoking a service.

methods.name: EntityEcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition based on an XML element and flags indicating if it's a constant or service condition.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given entity value and context, possibly invoking a service or performing a comparison.

methods.name: getLValue
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side value name of the condition.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side value or constant value as a string.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the condition object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityEcaCondition object.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns a list of field names involved in the condition.
